items.title: Resonance lower bounds for the number-field Piltz divisor error with splitting-density logarithmic exponents
items.author: Nilmoni Karak; Kamalakshya Mahatab
items.difficulty_reason: The main arbitrary-number-field Omega result combines a generalized Voronoi smoothing transform with a resonator built from prescribed counts of splitting-prime types, optimizes the density-dependent prime-factor parameters and controls the truncation/resonance errors at the logarithmic scales. Old180637 only contains a smoothing/maximal-discrepancy lemma310–335; the full resonator/parameter optimization and global bound are additional nonroutine content. Originalmk>=2 and exactbeta/gamma retained. Omega+ is asserted only forkr1=3mod8 andOmega- only forkr1=7mod8, not universal two-sided oscillation. Classical divisor/circle examples are uncounted specializations; no computations rerun or author proof certified.
